def asHumanly(self, tzinfo=None, now=None, precision=Precision.MINUTES):
        """Return this time as a short string, tailored to the current time.

        Parts of the date that can be assumed are omitted. Consequently, the
        output string depends on the current time. This is the format used for
        displaying dates in most user visible places in the quotient web UI.

        By default, the current time is determined by the system clock. The
        current time used for formatting the time can be changed by providing a
        Time instance as the parameter 'now'.

        @param precision: The smallest unit of time that will be represented
        in the returned string.  Valid values are L{Time.Precision.MINUTES} and
        L{Time.Precision.SECONDS}.

        @raise InvalidPrecision: if the specified precision is not either
        L{Time.Precision.MINUTES} or L{Time.Precision.SECONDS}.
        """
        passing a
                :class:`datetime.tzinfo` object.

                The precision of the output string can be controlled by passing a
                :class:`Precision` object.

                :param tzinfo:
                    A :class:`datetime.tzinfo` object that is used to determine the
                    current time. If ``None``, the system clock is used.

                :param now:
                    A :class:`datetime.datetime` object that is used to determine the
                    current time. If ``None``, the system clock is used.

                :param precision:
                    A :class:`Precision` object that controls the precision of the
                    output string.

                :return:
                    A string that represents the time.
                """
                if tzinfo is None:
                    tzinfo = self.tzinfo
                if now is None:
                    now = datetime.datetime.now(tzinfo)
                if self.tzinfo is None:
                    self = self.replace(tzinfo=tzinfo)
                if self.tzinfo is None:
                    raise ValueError('timezone information is missing')
                if self.tzinfo is not tzinfo:
                    raise ValueError('timezone information does not match')
                if self.tzinfo.utcoffset(self) is None:
                    raise ValueError('timezone information is not valid')
                if self.tzinfo.utcoffset(self) != tzinfo.utcoffset(now):
                    raise ValueError('timezone information does not match')
                if self.tzinfo.dst(self) != tzinfo.dst(now):
                    raise ValueError('timezone information does not match')
                if self.tzinfo.dst(self) is None:
                    raise ValueError('timezone information is missing')
                if self.tzinfo.dst(self) != tzinfo.dst(now):

                if self.tzinfo.dst(self) is None:
                    raise ValueError('timezone information is missing')
                if self.tzinfo.dst(self) != tzinfo.dst(now):
                    raise ValueError('timezone information does not match')
                if self
